newsitem.title: USA: Virginia jobless rate dips to 3.9 percent in April.
newsitem.headline: Virginia jobless rate dips to 3.9 percent in April.

text.p: Virginia's unemployment rate dipped to 3.9 percent in April from 4.0 percent in March and 4.0 percent a year ago, the state Employment Commission said.
The state traditionally sees its lowest rates in April as the construction and tourism sectors gear up, but it was the first time in seven years that the rate had dropped below 4.0 percent.
About 17,000 jobs were added in tourism in April and 5,000 in construction.
The May and June unemployment rates are expected to rise as students enter the job market, the commission said.
Manassas Park had the state's lowest unemployemnt rate for April, 1.4 percent, and Lancaster County had the highest, 17.2 percent.
